description: Configuration settings module for a FastAPI project using Pydantic, defining environment variables, database connection, CORS, email, and security settings.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A Pydantic-based configuration class that loads environment variables, manages application settings, and enforces security best practices.

methods.name: parse_cors
methods.description: Parses CORS origin configuration, converting comma-separated strings into a list or returning the input if already a list or string.

methods.name: _set_default_emails_from
methods.description: Sets default email sender name if not provided, based on project name.

methods.name: _check_default_secret
methods.description: Checks if secret values are set to default insecure placeholder and warns or raises an error.

methods.name: _enforce_non_default_secrets
methods.description: Validates that secret configuration values are not set to default insecure placeholders.
